messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Is there a way to pass a 0-length vector as data in RStan?
parts:
I'm thinking of something like...

data {
  int N;
  real y[N];
}
...


and I want to pass from R
data <- list()
data$N <- 0
data$y <- numeric(0)

or something else for data$y that can be passed rstan.

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to pass a 0-length vector as data in RStan?
parts:
numeric(0) should work actually. For instance this should run:

stancode <- "

data {
   int N;
   real y[N];
}

parameters {
   real x;
 }
 model{
   x ~ normal(0,1);
 }
"

fit <- stan(model_code = stancode, data = list(N = 0, y = numeric(0)), chains = 1, iter = 10)
